title: mini-sprint-failure-modes-and-mitigation-sep12-2028
content:
Mini-sprint: failure modes and mitigation — applied-ml research notes (quantization, evals, model onboarding)
Date: 2028-09-12
Owner: Priya Reddy
Attendees: Priya, Marco, Lian, Sameer, Hannah, Evan (async notes captured)

Context / objective:
- Short 4-day mini-sprint to validate 4-bit and 3-bit quantization candidates for rwk-7B variants, exercise our eval harness (instr-following + summarization), and run a constrained canary rollout on Dedicated.
- Goal: surface brittle failure modes that the full onboarding checklist misses (KV cache correctness, prefix caching, microbatch edge cases) and capture concrete mitigations.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Three repeatable failure modes found; two are high priority for blocker tickets before a wider rollout.
  1) KV cache misalignment when switching between quantized and full-precision shards under continuous batching (causes hallucinations / token repetitions).
  2) Eval drift for instruction-following tasks after aggressive activation quant (3-bit) on the last two transformer blocks — consistent ROUGE/EM drop on small number of prompt templates.
  3) Microbatch latency outliers when cold-KV + async compaction runs coincide (spike to 3x p95 for short windows).
- Immediate actions: create hotfix for cache alignment (AM-4129), expand eval templates and add regression thresholds (AM-4132), and adjust compaction scheduling + microbatch backoff logic.

Observations & evidence:
1) KV cache misalignment (severity: high)
- Symptoms: repeating tokens + abrupt semantic regressions for multi-turn chat logs when a quantized model variant is routed into a route that previously used full-precision.
- Repro steps (short): run 2000 mixed-length chat requests through continuous batching runtime with the following sequence: (a) serve full-precision for first 1k, (b) flip to rwk-7B-4bit for 500 requests, (c) flip back. Observe repeating tokens ~5% of sessions.
- Logs: interleaved cache flush markers present but index offsets mismatch when kernel path changes. Heap snapshot shows different KV lengths for quant vs fp path.
- Temporary mitigation we tested: force per-connection cache invalidation on model-variant switch — fixes repeats but increases token cost and latency for first request.

2) Eval drift after aggressive activation quant (severity: medium-high)
- Metric deltas (sample): instruction-following accuracy down 4–6% absolute on curated templates; summarization ROUGE-L down 2.3 points on the small eval set.
- Not all prompts affected — affects templates that use chained conditional instructions (e.g., "if X then Y else Z" patterns).
- Hypothesis: quantization noise amplifies in the last blocks during fine-grained compositional reasoning.
- Experiment attempted: mixed-precision last-2-blocks fp, rest 3-bit quant -> improves metric partially but increases GPU memory ~300MB.
- Action: expand eval suite with additional chaining templates and add automatic alert when deviance > 2% absolute on master baseline for core templates. (See AM-4132)

3) Microbatch latency outliers (severity: medium)
- Observed p95 spikes to ~3x baseline in a ~10-minute window during load tests when compaction + cold-KV events aligned.
- Root cause: compaction job holds a global lock on certain memory lanes while async KV compaction finalizes; newly arriving microbatches block on kernel selection path.
- Mitigation attempted: stagger compaction windows and add probabilistic backoff for microbatch size selection; reduced spike amplitude but not entirely eliminated.

Other smaller issues noticed:
- Model id collision: rollout config pinning used shorthand tag "rwk-7b-4b" which collided with a local staging alias; caused a small fraction of canary traffic to go to wrong artifact. Fix: enforce canonical artifact refs in rollout API.
- Eval harness: some RLHF-style prompts lacked normalization step (tokenization differences across beam/rw-tokenizer) -> add tokenizer normalization to eval preproc.

Decisions made in sprint:
- Blocker for wider rollout: must fix KV cache alignment before we enable continuous batching across model-variant switches. Will ship hotfix (AM-4129).
- Add 12 new prompt templates (chaining/edge-case) to the canonical eval suite; compute new baselines this week and store as pinned artifacts.
- Adjust compaction scheduler to avoid overlap with peak microbatch windows; schedule experiments to test impact on p95.

Action items (owner, what, ETA):
- Priya: write and submit KV alignment hotfix PR, include unit tests and sim harness (JIRA AM-4129). ETA: 2028-09-15
- Lian: expand eval templates (+normalization) and run baseline sweep for rwk-7B family; store baseline artifacts. ETA: 2028-09-17
- Marco: add rollout API validation to reject non-canonical artifact tags and add CI check. ETA: 2028-09-14
- Sameer: tweak compaction scheduler and run load test 9/18 to verify p95 improvement; include telemetry dashboard updates. ETA: 2028-09-18
- Hannah: investigate mixed-precision partial-fp strategy cost tradeoffs and provide cost/latency table for product. ETA: 2028-09-19
- Evan: add smoke tests for microbatch/kv cold path in the integration suite. ETA: 2028-09-16

Open questions / discussion items:
- Is the per-connection cache invalidation acceptable as a temporary mitigation given cost/latency hit? Product impact review needed.
- Should we adopt a default policy that routes model-variant switches through a short warmup queue to avoid cache mismatch? Pros/cons?
- For evaluation thresholds: what absolute delta is tolerable for instruction-following vs summarization for a canary release? Proposed: 2% absolute instruction-following, 1.5 ROUGE-L for summarization.

Notes to self (informal):
- Need a checklist item: "verify tokenizer normalization across eval tooling" (caught one mismatch today).
- Keep shorter repro harnesses (<= 2k requests) that can run in CI on small GPU for quick regression checks.
- Consider adding a low-overhead cache version tag to tracing so we can quickly filter sessions that experienced variant switches.

Appendix: quick repro commands (internal)
- repro-kv-repeat.sh (local harness): run --model-sequence full->4bit->full --requests 2000 --batching continuous --log-level debug
- eval-sweep command (internal): eval-harness --suite chaining-templates --model rwk-7B-3bit --save-artifact baseline-2028-09-12

End of notes. Will update after hotfix PR lands and baseline sweep completes.

-- Priya
